summary: Frontend E2E test of Shell Migration for MaterialsManager (118 lines), TilesManager (108 lines), FlooringManager (96 lines) all on ManagerPageShell. All 3 pages load, all 6 header buttons resolve with correct testids, sub-tabs render, search filters, edit modal opens, tier pricing modal opens with CORRECT per-manager defaults (Materials=£/unit + fixed, Tiles/Flooring=% + m²), legacy link present, workspace tabs bar renders, regression pages (bathroom/tools/custom-manager/grout-sealants) still work. HOWEVER, DB-persisted config from useManagerConfig(categoryKey) OVERRIDES the new editFields/subTabs props declared in the rewritten files — so newly-added select dropdowns (tiles material/finish/slip/edge/type) render as plain <input>, and materials number fields (bag_weight_kg, coverage_m2_per_bag, setting_time_hours, pot_life_minutes, application_thickness_mm, voc_rating) plus the 'Other' sub-tab are MISSING at runtime. Migration is correct in source code; the persisted DB config from a prior session is masking the improvements.

ui_bugs.issue: Select fields render as <input> with 0 <option> children. Expected <select> with Porcelain/Ceramic/etc. Root cause: config.spec_fields loaded from DB via useManagerConfig() overrides the editFields prop (ManagerPageShell.jsx line 130-132). Stored config lacks type:'select' + options metadata. Missing entirely: thickness, edge, type, made_in fields.

Number fields absent from modal because DB config overrides prop. Missing testids: materials-edit-bag_weight_kg, materials-edit-setting_time_hours, materials-edit-pot_life_minutes, materials-edit-application_thickness_mm, materials-edit-voc_rating. Only color/bag_colour/coverage_m2_per_bag/suitability render.

DB config.sub_tabs overrides subTabs prop. UI shows [All/Adhesives/Grouts/Sealants/Cleaning/Primers] (6 tabs from DB) instead of code's [All/Adhesives/Grouts/Sealants/Cleaning/Other]. Testids materials-tab-adhesives, -grouts, -sealants, -other do NOT resolve (keys differ). Only materials-tab-all and materials-tab-cleaning resolve.
tiles-tab-feature does not resolve (count=0) — likely DB stored a different key or that tab wasn't persisted.
suitability and made_in testids not resolving (DB config override — same root cause).
React console warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' — pre-existing, unrelated to this migration.

integration_issues.issue: useManagerConfig fetches persisted spec_fields/sub_tabs and unconditionally overrides component props. When prop-level fields are richer than DB (new metadata like type:'select', new number fields), users cannot access the new fields until they update the DB config via Configure modal — invisible upgrade.

verified_working: MaterialsManager loads with 138 products, title 'Materials Manager', subtitle 'Adhesives, grouts, sealants, cleaning & primers'
All 6 header testids resolve on all 3 managers: {cat}-add-new-btn, -configure-btn, -csv-import-btn, -refresh-btn, -search-input, -visible-count
Search narrows the count on all managers (verified)
Sub-tab switching updates count (Grouts=3, Cleaning=2, Primers=3; Tiles floor tab narrows from 1108 to 1065; Flooring LVT=0)
Edit modal opens with description textarea and save button on all 3
Bulk select + Tier Pricing modal opens on all 3
Materials tier defaults: unit='units', trade discount label='Trade Discount (£/unit)', '£/unit' suffix visible → matches trade_discount_type:'fixed', trade_discount_default:2 spec ✅
Tiles tier defaults: unit='m²', trade discount label='Trade Discount (%)' → matches percent + 5% spec ✅
Flooring tier defaults: unit='m²', trade discount '%' → matches percent + 5% spec ✅
Legacy full editor link (/admin/supplier-products) present on all 3 migrated pages
Regression: /admin/bathroom (46 visible), /admin/tools (0 visible), /admin/custom-manager/grout-sealants (3 visible) still load with shell
Code-size reduction confirmed: 783+693+545+688=2709 original → 118+108+96+218=540 refactored ≈ 80% reduction
action_items: HIGH: Decide merge strategy for useManagerConfig — either (a) merge props+DB (props provide the schema, DB adds/hides fields but preserves type/options), or (b) purge stored config.spec_fields/sub_tabs for materials/tiles/flooring so the new prop-level definitions take effect, or (c) auto-migrate stored config by re-seeding with the new type:'select' + number metadata.

HIGH: Verify that tiles Edit modal renders <select> with expected options (Porcelain/Ceramic/Natural Stone/Glass/Mosaic for material; Matt/Polished/... for finish; R9-R13 for slip; Rectified/Non-rectified/Bevelled for edge; Floor Tile/Wall Tile/... for type). Currently blocked by DB override — code is correct but never reached at runtime.
HIGH: Verify materials Edit modal exposes bag_weight_kg, setting_time_hours, pot_life_minutes, application_thickness_mm, voc_rating with type='number'.
MEDIUM: Reconcile the 'Other' vs 'Primers' Materials sub-tab — DB has 'Primers' preset; code declares 'Other'. Align expectations or clear DB.
LOW: Fix React 'unique key prop' warning in AdminDashboard (pre-existing).
critical_code_review_comments: ManagerPageShell useManagerConfig override is unconditional — this is a silent-upgrade blocker for any Manager migration that adds richer field metadata. Consider deep-merging config over props while preserving type/options from props when DB entries omit them.
Same file (ManagerPageShell.jsx) is 660 lines — nearing the recommended 700-line ceiling. Consider extracting the Edit dialog and Tier Pricing wiring into subcomponents.
Tiles Manager visible count is 1108 — very large single fetch (/api/supplier-sync/products?limit=5000). Consider paginating server-side for perf.

success_rate.frontend: 70% — shell integration + tier pricing + tabs bar + regression all pass, but edit-field metadata is silently dropped by DB override

context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent resolves the useManagerConfig override precedence (or clears stored spec_fields for materials/tiles/flooring), re-verify: (1) tiles-edit-material/finish/slip_rating/edge/type render as <select> with correct options; (2) materials-edit-bag_weight_kg is type='number' + coverage_m2_per_bag, setting_time_hours, pot_life_minutes, application_thickness_mm, voc_rating all resolve; (3) materials-tab-other resolves; (4) tiles-tab-feature resolves; (5) flooring-edit-suitability + flooring-edit-made_in resolve. All other flows already confirmed working.
rca of the issue: ManagerPageShell.jsx lines 127-132 unconditionally prefer config.sub_tabs and config.spec_fields from useManagerConfig(categoryKey) over the props supplied by the wrapper Managers. The rewritten Materials/Tiles/Flooring pages declare richer editFields (type:'select' with options for Tiles; type:'number' fields for Materials) and new sub_tabs, but a Configure-modal save from a prior session persisted a simpler spec_fields/sub_tabs shape (labels+keys only, no type/options). At runtime the DB config wins → new features invisible. Reproduction: /admin/tiles → Edit any row → inspect [data-testid='tiles-edit-material'] → tagName is INPUT, not SELECT. Mitigation options listed under action_items.
